data.name: Artemis 64 KiB matched RAM bank kit
data.installation: Matched pair only, with power off. Do not mix module densities in one chassis. High-density conversion replaces all low-density modules.
data.qualification_status: Accepted offering baseline; host revision and electrical qualification pending.
manufacturing_requirements: New production RAM assembly: freeze connector, PCB, power rails, qualified speed, identification and electrical tests.
